scripts.dev:makruk: concurrently -n worker,web -c yellow,green "npm run dev -w apps/makruk/worker" "npm run dev -w apps/makruk/web"
scripts.dev:sittuyin: concurrently -n worker,web -c yellow,green "npm run dev -w apps/sittuyin/worker" "npm run dev -w apps/sittuyin/web"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build:makruk: npm run build -w apps/makruk/web && npm run build -w apps/makruk/worker
scripts.build:sittuyin: npm run build -w apps/sittuyin/web && npm run build -w apps/sittuyin/worker
scripts.deploy:makruk: npm run build -w apps/makruk/web && npm run deploy -w apps/makruk/worker
scripts.deploy:sittuyin: npm run build -w apps/sittuyin/web && npm run deploy -w apps/sittuyin/worker
